title: NIST WebBook: Ethane gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 3 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Ethane. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Ethane (CAS 74-84-0) print: -84. ± 0.4 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Manion, 2002, comment: adopted recommendation of Gurvich, Veyts, et al., 1991 ; DRB (experimental or compiled row) | -83.8 ± 0.3 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Pittam and Pilcher, 1972, comment: ALS (experimental or compiled row) | -84.67 ± 0.49 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Prosen and Rossini, 1945, comment: Hf derived from Heat of Hydrogenation; ALS (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
